request: Classify physical idle AI Core cgroup file cache into mapped, dirty, writeback, shmem, inactive/active to judge reclaimability without clearing caches or running models.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/sys/fs/cgroup/ai.slice/ai-core.slice
s=$(awk '$1=="file"||$1=="file_mapped"||$1=="file_dirty"||$1=="file_writeback"||$1=="shmem"||$1=="inactive_file"||$1=="active_file"{printf "%s=%s ",$1,$2}' "$p/memory.stat")
msg="AI_CORE_IDLE_CACHE_RECLAIMABILITY $s"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
echo AI_CORE_IDLE_CACHE_METRICS=POSTED

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: Core Issue#1 #6224282940 real resident0, memory.current 19,039,088,640, anon 16,732,160, file18,974,511,104, PSI0, swap0. Need cache mapped/dirty/unmapped classification before claiming freed RAM. No force cache drop or model start.
